title: Reliability of short molecular dynamics runs as screening labels: code and derived data
description: JCS submission snapshot v1.0.12 of the analysis code and compact inputs for 'Reliability of Short Molecular Dynamics Runs as Screening Labels: Noise Ceilings, Time Dependence and Adaptive Replicate Allocation'. Includes the conductivity analysis, all 50 SCAYLE pilot runs and 20 HTP-MD controls with dispersion by run type, the allocation analysis with the long run as target and a descriptive normal-threshold detectability diagnostic, system-bootstrap intervals and manuscript sources. Model-derived oracle recall is conditional on a calibrated Gaussian sensitivity model; the diagnostic is not calibrated power of the real-run bootstrap test. No combined reliability confidence interval is asserted. Code is MIT-licensed; data rights and upstream CC BY-NC 4.0 notices are specified in LICENSE-data and resultados/README_fuentes.md. All tables, numbers and figures are regenerated from released inputs; raw trajectories are not redistributed.
